newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Moderate earthquake shakes South Australia.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Moderate earthquake shakes South Australia.

text.p: A moderate earthquake shook large, mostly unpopulated areas of South Australia on Wednesday, government and seismology officials said.
The earthquake, which occurred across a wide area north of Adelaide, was estimated at between 4.5 and 5.0 on the Richter scale by the South Australian Mines and Energy Department.
David Love, from the state's seismological centre said: "We estimate the epicentre is about 140 km north of Adelaide in a fairly unpopulated area".
There were no reports of damage or injury.
Destructive earthquakes are rare in Australia, the oldest and most stable continent.
